title: AgentEvent
description: Every change that drives the QianPulse agent runtime. Emitted by agent/server/a2a6-live-runtime.js (runProactive, runBuyerMessage) and by webhooks/smartlead-router.js. Persisted to state.events before any capability runs; the idempotency_key dedupes replays.

opportunity_id.description: null for SELLER_PROACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT (opportunity does not exist yet); set for every buyer-side event.

payload.description: Event-specific. For BUYER_MESSAGE: { message: { content, evidence_ref, source_message_id }, field_updates? }. For SELLER_PROACTIVE_DEVELOPMENT: the A2 input contract.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Missing -> IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED. A replayed key returns the cached result.
